midi-qol.RAW2024Invisible.Hint: RAW (2024) Only grants adv/disadv if the other creature cannot see you — blindsight/truesight negate, but tremorsense does not.

midi-qol.ConditionRules.Name: Apply condition rules
midi-qol.ConditionRules.Hint: Applies the condition rules dnd5e doesn't, to conditions added after it is turned on, however they are added: attacks by a frightened, poisoned, prone or restrained creature (or one with 2014 exhaustion 3) have disadvantage; attacks against a paralyzed, petrified, restrained, stunned or unconscious creature have advantage, and against a prone one advantage within 5 ft and disadvantage beyond; hits within 5 ft on a paralyzed or unconscious creature are critical; paralyzed, petrified, stunned and unconscious creatures fail Strength and Dexterity saves; frightened creatures have disadvantage on ability checks; silenced creatures can't cast spells with a verbal component; blinded follows these rules only when the can't-see rules are off. Grappled is not included.
